mechanism: Pyrazinamide causes hyperuricemia which may precipitate gout; tazarotene is a retinoid with potential for additive hepatotoxicity and teratogenicity concerns.
action: Monitor liver function tests and uric acid levels; avoid tazarotene in pregnancy (both drugs have teratogenic potential); counsel on contraception if using tazarotene with pyrazinamide-containing TB regimens.
